verdict.rationale: Deel's API/MCP docs show contract creation, listing contracts, time-off requests, and payroll/EOR cost comparisons, and the API supports creating contracts via POST /rest/contracts, suggesting an agent could programmatically onboard a contractor. However, there is no explicit documented endpoint or MCP tool for full employee onboarding covering compensation setup and tax setup as a single end-to-end workflow — the evidence only shows contract creation and cost comparison tools, not a unified 'create employee + compensation + tax' flow. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP endpoints for employee creation with compensation configuration, dedicated tax-setup endpoint/tool, and a documented end-to-end onboarding workflow example or independent confirmation it works as described.
